nom: Amazon Basics Rose Water Hydrating Facial Toner

avis.titre: Not sticky at all! Smells good!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Rose Water Hydrating Toner for a while now, and it’s quickly become one of my favorite skincare products! After a long, busy day, this toner feels absolutely amazing on my skin. It’s like a refreshing, gentle cleanse that wipes away all the stress and grime from the day. I always feel so much cleaner and more refreshed after using it, without any harsh or tight feeling that some toners can leave behind. What really stands out to me is how light and non-sticky it is. A lot of toners I’ve tried in the past would leave my skin feeling sticky or like there was a residue, but not with this one. It absorbs so well and leaves my face feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated. I never feel like there’s a layer of product sitting on my skin, which I absolutely love. The scent is another huge plus. It smells absolutely wonderful—fresh, light, and subtle. It’s just enough to feel calming and luxurious without being overpowering or irritating, which is a problem I’ve had with other rose water products. The scent is just right, adding a soothing element to my skincare routine without being too much. What I also appreciate is that a little goes a long way. I only need a few drops on a cotton pad to get the job done, which makes the bottle last a good amount of time. It’s so effective at cleansing and hydrating that I don’t feel the need to drench my face in it. Just a few swipes with the toner and my skin feels totally refreshed and balanced. avis.titre: A Pleasant, Effective and Inexpensive Toner
avis.texte: I’m an old guy (nearly 80) who looks somewhat younger and still have some vestigial vanity. I’ve been using a variety of products to keep my face looking healthy and moisturized and this skin toner definitely helps. I’ve put it into a smaller spray bottle that I can carry around so I can give myself an extra spritz when needed. In hot weather I keep the spray bottle in the fridge – very refreshing to use in the midst of a midwestern summer! The scent is very mild and not lingering but pleasant when it’s being applied. The toner does help keep my skin looking less dry and the witch hazel does tighten things up a bit. I’m not looking for things that will make me look like a teenager (fat chance!) but that keep me looking healthy and less aged and this helps accomplish that! Plus it’s pleasant to use.

Out of all the other expensive toners I have used over the years, this is one of the best ones so far. It doesn’t sting my skin, my skin feels so refreshed and hydrated. Smells amazing and nothing can beat the price for the amount you get. I use it after I wash my face and I also pat it on my lips before putting on my lip balm. Since I’ve been doing this my lips have been much more hydrated too. This bottle will last a long time. I’ve been using it everyday for the past few months and I haven’t even used half the bottle yet. I will totally be buying this again!

avis.titre: Amazing value, leaves skin soft and hydrated!
avis.texte: This toner is such a steal for a little under $5! You get a surprisingly big bottle; I’ve been using it daily for two months and I'm only halfway through. The scent is definitely more witch hazel than rose, but it performs beautifully. It leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated, and I’ve noticed that the rest of my skincare products absorb much better when I apply this first. Plus, the bottle itself is just simple and cute. Absolutely adore it!

avis.titre: Cool and refreshing hydrating toner! Incredible value!
avis.texte: I recently started doing a skin care routine to help with the dry and dull skin on my face and just added this rose water toner to my routine based on peoples comments and reviews on the serum and moisturizer products I use (I had never heard of Rose water before!). I was shocked to see how inexpensive this toner is and ordered it right away. My forehead tends to get oily throughout the day (even with morning and evening moisturizer) however I have noticed that since I have added this to my routine it has helped significantly with that issue. It takes a very small amount on a cotton ball to cover entire face and neck so the 16oz bottle will last a very long time. It feels so cool and refreshing when applying. I apply after washing my face but somehow it still gets more oil and grime off! I wait a few minutes for it to dry and then apply a hyaluronic acid serum and moisturizer and my skin looks and feels great, firm and smooth! I tend to have sensitive skin and I have not had any issues with this product at all. I will definitely continue using this in my morning and evening routine. I highly recommend it! Update: I have also since tried the Pore Perfecting Toner (Witch Hazel water) of this same brand, and it does not smell good at all! I definitely prefer this Rose Water with Witch Hazel Toner.
